title: Unraveling Groundwater Stress: A Model Generalizable Across Space and Time Reveals Co-Declining Water Tables and Recharge Across Bangladesh
abstract: arXiv:2503.22771v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Is Bangladesh replenishing the groundwater it depends on? Answering this question remains difficult in Bangladesh and worldwide because sparse in-situ measurements limit observational capabilities, while existing machine-learning approaches struggle to generalize across time and space. To address this bottleneck, we develop a Teacher-Student framework in which a Teacher accurately learns from sparse annual in-situ minimum (R2 = 0.86) and maximum (R2 = 0.96) depth observations to generate dense spatial patterns, and a Student transfers these patterns from time-varying 25-km GLDAS groundwater storage to high-resolution (2-km) depth maps using location-specific features. The Student achieves R2 = 0.93 over 2003-2022 and generalizes across unseen years (Leave-One-Year-Out R2 = 0.93) and locations (Leave-One-District-Out R2 = 0.70), enabling reconstruction without contemporary in-situ measurements. translated_title: 解析地下水压力：一个可跨时空泛化的模型揭示孟加拉国地下水位与补给量同步下降
translated_abstract: 孟加拉国所依赖的地下水是否正在得到补给？在孟加拉国乃至全球范围内，回答这一问题仍然困难，因为稀疏的实地观测限制了观测能力，而现有的机器学习方法难以在时间和空间上实现泛化。为突破这一瓶颈，我们开发了一个“教师-学生”框架：教师模型从稀疏的年度实地最小（R² = 0.86）和最大（R² = 0.96）地下水埋深观测中学习，生成密集的空间模式；学生模型利用特定位置的特征，将这些模式从随时间变化的25公里分辨率GLDAS地下水储量数据迁移到高分辨率（2公里）的地下水埋深图中。学生模型在2003-2022年间达到R² = 0.93，并能在未见过的年份（留一年交叉验证R² = 0.93）和地点（留一地区交叉验证R² = 0.70）上实现泛化，从而无需同期实地观测即可完成地下水重建。重建结果揭示了广泛存在的……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究提出一种可跨时空泛化的“教师-学生”机器学习框架，将稀疏实地观测与GLDAS卫星数据结合，生成孟加拉国2公里高分辨率地下水埋深图，并揭示了地下水位与地下水补给量正在同步下降。
en_tdlr: This study develops a Teacher-Student machine learning framework generalizable across space and time, which combines sparse in-situ observations with GLDAS satellite data to generate 2-km high-resolution groundwater depth maps, revealing co-declining water tables and recharge across Bangladesh.
